checks.title: Confirm trial assist goal and owners
checks.instructions: Name the product-data owner, seller, contact approver and first reviewable result. Decide whether the job is assistance, qualification or no-contact review; record excluded sends and CRM writes.

checks.title: Bind one exact trial account
checks.instructions: Record entity, product, tenant, product account, trial and subscription IDs, current status/revision, trial start/end, timezone, internal/test exclusions and observation cutoff. A company name or email alone is not the join.

checks.title: Freeze use and coverage rules
checks.instructions: Choose one customer-defined qualifying event rule and bounded window. Read exact event IDs and coverage source; distinguish observed use, complete-window non-observation and unknown partial coverage. Usage is not purchase intent.

checks.title: Set Sales fit and contact policy
checks.instructions: Record exact product-account-to-CRM-account mapping, approved recipient and channel, fit decision, consent basis, suppression scope, prior replies, meetings, current trial/paid state, offer revision and review owner. A trial signup is not blanket outreach permission.

checks.title: Bind existing Product and Sales Crews
checks.instructions: Inspect Product Adoption Analyst and Sales Follow-up Coordinator for compatible owner, access and selected v3 skills. Record project/trigger IDs and only propose a new Crew where an actual boundary requires it.

checks.title: Probe real source access
checks.instructions: Read one authorized current trial/subscription record, matching product event or coverage proof, exact CRM mapping and current contact/suppression and prior-contact state. Save source IDs, revisions, observation times and missing access.

checks.title: Gate the trial-to-Sales artifact
checks.instructions: Save Product Adoption's exact JSON context output, require load-bearing fields with a Crew validation schema, then run the bundled business validator before Sales consumes it. Reject wrong account, partial-coverage inactivity, converted-trial outreach, mismatched recipient, unknown permission, false send or false meeting. Test valid and rejected fixtures.

checks.title: Review the concrete Automation
checks.instructions: Show Crew IDs, source and output paths, structural and business gates, CRM join, no-contact branch, recipient and draft review, action ledger, later delivery/meeting receipts and manual route before Builder applies it.

checks.title: Run one authorized trial manually
checks.instructions: Use one real or historical authorized trial with current source records. Save Crew run IDs, validator results, owner fit/contact decision, an unsent draft or no-contact result and actual later provider state or unknown. Fictional examples do not complete setup.

checks.title: Choose recurrence and action ledger
checks.instructions: Record trial/account/status revision, usage artifact ID, CRM mapping, recipient, contact policy revision, message fingerprint, owner approval, provider receipt and next check. Choose manual-only or a reviewed authenticated event/schedule; setup completion enables no send.
